body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 panel review addendum (Beamfall fit and corvint-tasks), scratchpad review/out/panel-addendum.md. §6 item 6. **Verify:** is present on 87% of Beamfall tickets; admitting it as a declared intent form makes the owner-written ticket the obligation set.
